headline: E.ON installed over 1,200 photovoltaic systems for residential customers in the first 6 months of 2026, up 30%, and 91% of systems include storage batteries, compared with only 10% in previous years
summary: E.ON Energie Romania installed over 1,200 residential photovoltaic systems in the first half of 2026, up 30%. 91% of systems included storage batteries.
why: E.ON is a major European utility, and rising rooftop solar and battery adoption shifts its residential energy business in Romania.

original_headline: E.ON a instalat în primele 6 luni din 2026 peste 1.200 de sisteme fotovoltaice pentru clienţii rezidenţiali, în creştere cu 30%, iar 91% sisteme includ baterii de stocare, faţă de doar 10% anii trecuţi
